# Manifest 格式

服务的 Manifest 是一份 JSON 文档（`format` 1）：它的限界上下文、上下文中的聚合及其命令与事件、订阅、框架的错误码，以及 `$defs` 之下每个载荷的 JSON Schema 2020-12。模块的片段（`META-INF/wow/manifest/<module>.json`）形状相同，只是没有 `service`。下面每个对象及其键的提纲，由写出它的代码 [`ManifestTree`](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/blob/main/api/manifest/src/main/kotlin/me/ahoo/wow/manifest/ManifestTree.kt) 生成；说明取自源码，为英文。

写出时省略的内容：

Absent optional values (a null description, unknown `produces`, `derives`, `schedules` or `transformsTo`, a fragment's service, a subscription's `retry` or `job`) are left out, not written as null, and so are a subscription source's `nullableState` and a command's `mounted` when false, an aggregate's `ownership` when it is `OWNER`, the default, its `idSource` when it is `ASSIGNED`, the default, its `retired` events when it has none, and the Manifest's `requires` when it has none.

## `Manifest`

- `format`
- `requires`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `service`: 对象; 缺省或取默认值时省略
  - `name`
  - `version`
- `contexts`: 数组，元素为 [`Context`](#context)
- `errors`: 数组，元素为 [`Error`](#error)
- `$defs`

## `Context`

- `name`
- `description`
- `aggregates`: 数组，元素为 [`Aggregate`](#aggregate)
- `subscriptions`: 数组，元素为 [`Subscription`](#subscription)
- `published`: 对象数组
  - `aggregate`
  - `topic`
  - `includeState`
- `errors`: 数组，元素为 [`Error`](#error)
- `commands`: 数组，元素为 [`Command`](#command); 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `routes`: 数组，元素为 [`ServiceRoute`](#serviceroute); 缺省或取默认值时省略

## `ServiceRoute`

- `name`
- `route`
- `parameters`: 对象数组; 缺省或取默认值时省略
  - `name`
  - `in`
  - `schema`
  - `required`
- `request`
- `response`
- `errors`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `description`
- `deprecated`: 缺省或取默认值时省略

## `Command`

- `name`
- `aliases`
- `schema`
- `creation`
- `produces`
- `routes`: 数组，元素为 [`Route`](#route)
- `mounted`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `system`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `transformsTo`
- `description`

## `Error`

- `code`
- `status`
- `description`
- `retry`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `retryAfter`

## `Aggregate`

- `name`
- `description`
- `state`: 对象
  - `schema`
  - `fingerprint`
  - `view`
- `snapshot`: 对象
  - `enabled`
  - `stateRevision`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `commands`: 数组，元素为 [`Command`](#command)
- `events`: 对象数组
  - `name`
  - `aliases`
  - `revision`
  - `schema`
  - `description`
- `queries`: 对象数组
  - `model`
  - `routes`: 数组，元素为 [`Route`](#route)
- `schedules`
- `ownership`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `retired`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `idSource`: 缺省或取默认值时省略

## `Route`

- `method`
- `path`

## `Subscription`

- `name`
- `kind`
- `source`: 对象
  - `context`
  - `aggregates`
  - `events`
  - `eventSchemas`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
  - `nullableState`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `function`: 对象
  - `kind`
  - `context`
  - `processor`
  - `name`
- `derives`
- `rejected`
- `committed`
- `calls`
- `start`: 缺省或取默认值时省略
- `schedules`
- `retry`: 对象; 缺省或取默认值时省略
  - `maxAttempts`
  - `initialBackoff`
  - `maxBackoff`
  - `timeout`
  - `recoverable`
  - `unrecoverable`
  - `systemic`
  - `multiplier`
- `job`: 对象; 缺省或取默认值时省略
  - `name`
  - `cron`
  - `zone`
  - `scope`
  - `misfire`
